Hello Leo,

We have granted you access to the following groups to help you cover for Priya Nair while she is on leave:
- SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE (Confluence finance space)
- SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ (Finance Reports readers)

Your request for the group SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors) requires approval from your manager. We have sent a request to Grace Okafor for confirmation. We will update you once this is resolved.

Best regards,
IT Access Desk
